newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy basis offers drop, corn mixed.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy basis offers drop, corn mixed.

text.p: FOB Gulf soybean basis offers dropped one to four cents a bushel while corn was mixed.
Farmers have to realize that they have to start selling. "People are bearish," one dealer said. "They know they have to get their crop moving, particularly soybeans. You can't hold on to it forever."

On the other hand, hard red winter wheat FOB values strengthened, bolstered by sluggish movement from producing areas in the High Plains, traders said. "Slow replacement is coming in from the country," said one wheat trader in the U.S. High Plains.
